"MAX-A-MILLION" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $1 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "MAX-A-MILLION" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
